summary: Frontend-only verification of two bug fixes (Android blank sign-in + Expo Go silent sign-in failure). ALL SEVEN scenarios PASS on mobile viewport (390x844) against http://localhost:3000. (1) Sign-in mounts cleanly at /(auth)/sign-in: TEEBOX badge, 'Welcome back' title, sign-in-email, sign-in-password, sign-in-toggle-password, sign-in-remember-me, sign-in-submit, and sign-in-go-signup are all visible; ZERO pageerror events and ZERO console.error entries during mount (the root cause of the blank-screen symptom). (2) Happy path with sam@teebox.demo / password123 authenticates and navigates to /(tabs) with header-my-profile visible on Feed; no error banner. (3) Bogus password shows a helpful error in Text[testID=sign-in-error]: 'Incorrect email or password' (NOT generic 'Login failed'). (4) Network abort (page.route abort of **/api/auth/login) surfaces the exact fixed copy: 'Cannot reach the TeeBox server. Check your internet connection and try again.' — word match 'Cannot reach' confirmed; route restored after test. (5) Remember-me regression: checkbox ON + successful login persists teebox_remember_me='1', teebox_remember_email='sam@teebox.demo', teebox_remember_password (secure) in web localStorage; after profile-signout and return to sign-in the email and password fields rehydrate (pw length 11 = 'password123'). Lazy-require refactor of storage did not break persistence. (6) Sign-up screen renders: sign-up-screen, sign-up-name, sign-up-email, sign-up-password, sign-up-submit all visible; no console.error on mount. (7) Regression: Feed shows 'My Profile' header button, Discover defaults to Courses chip with 'Search courses…' placeholder, More tab labelled 'More', Log tab opens 'Log a round' form. The only console.error observed anywhere across all runs is a single 'Failed to load resource: net::ERR_FAILED' emitted by the intentional network abort in scenario 4 — expected and unrelated to app code. No React Native red screens, no deprecated-package usage found in the two files that were refactored (sign-in.tsx & sign-up.tsx now use core RN KeyboardAvoidingView + ScrollView, no react-native-keyboard-controller import).
action_items: None. Both reported bugs (blank sign-in on Android APK, silent Expo Go sign-in failure) are verified fixed via web-preview parity checks. Recommend main agent produce a fresh Android release APK to confirm the native-linking-blank-screen no longer reproduces on a device.
(Carry-over from iter16, unchanged) Optional: migrate 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and audit the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning source — not related to this bugfix.
critical_code_review_comments: sign-in.tsx no longer imports react-native-keyboard-controller — uses core RN KeyboardAvoidingView + ScrollView. This removes the native-module risk that caused the Android APK blank-screen.
sign-up.tsx same treatment — verified no third-party keyboard imports.

Storage adapter is lazy-required (require('@/src/utils/storage')) inside safeGetRemembered / safeSaveRemembered with a try/catch swallow. Even if the storage module fails to load, the form still renders and the user can sign in.

Error surface in sign-in.tsx onSubmit correctly detects /Failed to fetch|Network request failed|aborted|AbortError/i and maps to the user-friendly 'Cannot reach the TeeBox server…' copy; all other error messages are surfaced raw (e.g. 'Incorrect email or password') instead of the previous generic 'Login failed' fallback.
Remember-me persistence still happens ONLY after signIn resolves successfully — a bad password never writes credentials to storage.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sign-in mount is now free of native-module risk (verified 0 pageerror + 0 console.error). Bogus-password error path returns backend detail 'Incorrect email or password'. Network-abort path returns 'Cannot reach the TeeBox server. Check your internet connection and try again.' — use page.route('**/api/auth/login', lambda r: r.abort('failed')) to reproduce. Remember-me keys are localStorage on web preview (teebox_remember_me / teebox_remember_email / teebox_remember_password). Web preview cannot reproduce the original Android-release blank-screen since it's a native-linking issue — the code fix (removing KeyboardAwareScrollView) is validated by absence of the offending import and clean mount.
rca_of_issue: Bug #1 (Android blank sign-in): react-native-keyboard-controller's KeyboardAwareScrollView is a native module. In a signed Android release APK where autolinking hadn't produced a fully linked binary, importing that component at bundle-execution time threw a ReferenceError before React could render anything, blanking the screen. Fix (verified): sign-in.tsx & sign-up.tsx removed the import and use core RN KeyboardAvoidingView + ScrollView with zero native dependencies for the auth screens. Bug #2 (silent sign-in failure): onSubmit catch used `e?.message || 'Login failed'` so any thrown value that lacked a .message string (e.g. AbortError, TypeError from fetch) collapsed to the useless 'Login failed'. Fix (verified): expanded catch to (a) fallback via String(e), (b) regex-detect network-y errors and map to a specific message, and (c) surface all other messages verbatim so real backend detail like 'Incorrect email or password' reaches the user. Both fixes validated end-to-end via Playwright.
